rationale: Line 952 hardcodes the transfer semi-major axis to (R_EARTH_AU + R_MARS_AU)/2 ≈ 1.262 AU — the Earth-Mars Hohmann value — for every non-Moon mission. Once the spacecraft's heliocentric distance scR exceeds 2·a ≈ 2.52 AU, vis-viva's (2/r − 1/a) goes negative, Math.sqrt returns NaN, and the HUD reads 'NaN km/s' all the way out. Every outer-planet destination (Jupiter 5.2 AU, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, Ceres, comets) cruises well past that threshold. The fix is to replace the hardcoded Mars average with (R_EARTH_AU + DESTINATIONS[activeDestination].a)/2 so the transfer ellipse matches the actual destination; defensively clamping sqrt in fly-physics.ts would only mask the wrong input and still render a bogus zero instead of the true cruise speed.
